'''Brin'shak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] from the Shak clan and was a talent agent on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] who sent several female Twi'leks to work for [[Durga Besadii Tai]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].
